messages:
janet_cust: hey support — our invoice ingestion started failing ~30m ago after the model update. Our JSON parser throws: "Invalid control character at byte 412". The returned payload sometimes includes embedded NULs (\x00) and stray tokens after the top-level object. This is blocking payments for a few merchants, SLA is 4h. Example (redacted): ```{
  "invoice_id": "INV-1001",
  "total": 124.50,
  "lines": [ { "sku": "ABC", "qty": 2 } ],
  "meta": null\x00\x00
}garbage
``` Can someone escalate?

lina_support: sorry about that — can you confirm API version + model you called and whether you used structured/json mode or freeform? Also, do you have a request_id?

janet_cust: using POST /v1/generate, model=redwood-infer-2.3, json_mode="strict", request_id=rr-9f8a. We see it against ~10% of calls, not all. Happened right after the model rollout last night.

lina_support: thx. putting this on high priority. tagging eng oncall. @tom_eng @prateek_oncall can you triage?

tom_eng: looking. can you paste the raw response bytes (hex) for one sample? also, does the problem appear in streaming responses or only non-streaming?

janet_cust: attached a minimal hex snippet in the ticket: `7b 22 69 6e 76 6f 69 63 65 22 3a ... 00 00 7d 67 61 72 62 61 67 65` — so object end `7d` followed by ASCII "garbage". This was a non-streaming call.

prateek_oncall: initial hypothesis: a tokenizer/decoder bug in the new variant emitting extraneous sequence separators or an incomplete flush of the stream buffer leaving residual bytes. Another poss: post-processing that appends debug markers when truncation occurs. Repro plan: 1) replay request with same prompt+model pinned, 2) try older model (redwood-infer-2.2) 3) run response through safe sanitizer to strip non-printable bytes.

tom_eng: quick mitigation — if you can pin to redwood-infer-2.2 we expect immediate stability. I'll try to reproduce on staging with 2.3 pinned and the same sampling settings.

lina_support: janet, would you be OK temporarily pinning to 2.2 for the next 24-72h? We'll coordinate a rollback window if needed.

janet_cust: yes can pin. We need a mitigation path while you investigate — customers need processing.

prateek_oncall: created a short-lived response-sanitizer middleware you can enable by adding header `X-Redwood-Sanitize: strip-nonprint` to requests. It will remove control chars (\u0000-\u001F) and trim trailing non-json text. Not enabled by default because it can mask root causes. If you want it now, tell me and I can toggle for your org id.

janet_cust: please enable it and I'll validate. Also please open an incident for the model rollout so we can get timelines.

prateek_oncall: done — sanitizer enabled for org=acme-pay (applied to your request_id prefix). Also filed incident INC-2026 and linked your request_id.

tom_eng: repro update: I can reproduce a test-case where decoder emits an extra null + suffix when buffer flush happens under specific tokenization boundary. I have a minimal repro and am fixing decoder flush in runtime; rolling a hotfix to staging now.

lina_support: ETA for hotfix to production?

tom_eng: aiming for 2h to patch staging, 6h for canary + prod if green. Will update on progress. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

janet_cust: thanks. I validated sanitizer and our parser accepts the response now. It's slower but unblocks us. Please keep me posted on prod fix.

ticketbot: created ticket SUP-4821 and linked to INC-2026, priority=high, sla=4h

prateek_oncall: postmortem notes (short): root cause = decoder flush bug introduced in redwood-infer-2.3 variant -> occasionally emitted 0x00 and left trailing bytes. Immediate mitigations: 1) sanitizer header, 2) rollback/pin to 2.2, 3) hotfix to decoder. Next steps: full deploy plan for hotfix, add response validator in CI for structured/json mode, and add metric for \u0000 occurrences in responses.

lina_support: I'll follow up with customer comms template. Draft snippet: "We're aware of the issue affecting structured JSON responses for some customers after the 2.3 rollout. We've enabled a temporary sanitizer for your org and are testing a runtime fix; we'll provide updates and a full incident report."

janet_cust: appreciated. Please include list of impacted request_ids when you share the report.

tom_eng: will push updates to the incident thread and ping once prod patch is live.

prateek_oncall: prod patch deployed and verified on canary, rolling to prod now. Will monitor for 30m. :rocket:

janet_cust: seeing clean responses now for last 20 calls. Thanks team.

lina_support: closing the high-priority escalation once postmortem published. Thanks everyone.
